title: Kalyana Lakshmi Scheme Paper Checker
problem: A sister in our street faced major financial delay for her wedding support money because the bridegroom's age proof certificate was missing from the file.
idea: A paper checker game. The family ticks every paper before submitting the Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak application, so nothing is missing and the money is not delayed.

widgets.heading: ✅ Is the Application File Complete?
widgets.intro: Papers commonly asked for. The official list can change – confirm on the official website or at Mee Seva.

items.text: Bride's age proof (birth certificate / school certificate)
Income certificate of the bride's family
Aadhaar of bride, groom and bride's mother
Bank passbook of the person receiving the money
Photocopies of everything and passport-size photos

bands.text: File complete! Submit it and keep the application number.
Almost! One or two papers missing – that can delay the money.
Many papers missing. Do not submit yet.

questions.q: By law, the minimum marriage age for a girl in India is…
questions.why: Girls must be at least 18. Child marriage is a crime.

questions.q: By law, the minimum marriage age for a boy is…
Why keep photocopies of every paper?
options: As proof if the file is lost or questioned
questions.why: Copies help you follow up quickly.

questions.q: Someone says 'Pay me ₹5,000 and I'll get the scheme money fast'. You…
options: Refuse and apply through the official process
questions.why: Government schemes do not need bribes. Use the official way.

how: Ask Gemini for the general eligibility and documents for Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak in Telangana.
Confirm the latest list on the official website or at the Mee Seva centre.
In Scratch, make a sprite for each paper with a tick button.
Use a variable 'papers ready' that increases by 1 for every tick.
If all papers are ticked, show a green 'Ready to submit!' screen; otherwise show which ones are missing.
Test it with a family in our street before their application.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a checklist game. In simple Telugu and English, list the documents usually needed for the Kalyana Lakshmi / Shaadi Mubarak scheme in Telangana. Do not give amounts. Remind families to confirm the list on the official website or at Mee Seva.
